purpose: Teach: ルピー/一室/座敷/刺す/ザル/ローテーション/そりゃあ/ちまう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、世界のお金、絶対、ルピー、絶対、図鑑で見たわ
lines.en: Sho, I saw a picture of rupees in a book once — you know, like real-world money?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slightly conspiratorial tone — she's setting up a memory to share with him. Easy pace, like she's thinking back fondly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの家の、絶対、一室、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、お部屋なんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, that's so cool — is it like one of the rooms in my house? My room?
lines.style: Bright curiosity, pitched high with genuine interest. Quick, eager to understand the connection. No self-consciousness — just pure wonder at learning something new.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちの、絶対、座敷、絶対、お気に入りよ、翔くん
lines.en: Actually, Sho, Grandpa's tatami room is my favorite place — really is.
lines.style: Soft, tender affirmation. She's speaking more to herself than at him — settling into a true feeling. Warm and unhurried, like she's letting him see something real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お裁縫で、絶対、指を、絶対、刺す、絶対、ことが、絶対、あるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, sometimes I poke my finger when I'm sewing though. Actually happens.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered with a tiny wry smile in the voice. Deadpan almost — he's stating fact without drama. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、ザル、絶対、お蕎麦、絶対、翔くんに、絶対、作ってあげるね
lines.en: I'm going to make you proper zaru soba sometime, okay? My special one.
lines.style: Promise wrapped in tenderness. Confident but not showy — this is something she *will* do. Warm, close, like she's already picturing it. Soft close on the offer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、勤務、絶対、ローテーション、絶対、聞いたよ
lines.en: I heard about your dad's shift rotation, actually.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. He's saying something that matters but not making a point of it — just laying it down. Noticing without announcing that he's noticing. Still child-soft in delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そりゃあ、本気で、絶対、翔くん、絶対、毎日、絶対、頑張ってるから、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、応援するわ
lines.en: Of course I support you, Sho. You're trying every single day — I see that.
lines.style: Steady, certain tenderness. This is her speaking real conviction, not performing it. Slight emphasis on 'every day' — she means it. Warm and grounding, like an anchor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、おやつ、絶対、食べちまう、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm definitely going to eat all the snacks though.
lines.style: Playful confession delivered with warm laugh underneath. Animated, bright, close to her ear almost — like he's sharing a silly secret. Quick energy, genuine mischief.
